name: K-C Beech Island Regional Distribution Center - Beech Island SC
type: Automated regional distribution center (new ~1.1M sq ft, $200M, announced 2025)

fieldNotes.status: NOT YET BUILT. This is a $200M, ~1.1M sq ft automated regional distribution center announced May 2025 as an expansion of the existing K-C Beech Island plant at 246 Old Jackson Hwy. Per SC Governor's office and Manufacturing Dive, it is projected to be completed and operational in Q2 2027 and will add ~150 jobs.
fieldNotes.location: Roster coordinates (33.420989, -81.890666) geocode to undeveloped land / residential subdivisions north-east of the K-C plant - not a built DC. The DC is an expansion ON the existing 246 Old Jackson Hwy plant property; current (2026) satellite imagery shows only forest and the plant's existing north building edge in this area - no DC structure, docks, or yard yet exist.
fieldNotes.perimeter: Best-effort box over the undeveloped K-C-owned land along the north edge of the existing Beech Island plant, the most plausible build footprint. Not a measured fence line - the facility does not yet exist.
fieldNotes.classification: All physical-layout fields are unobservable because the building has not been constructed. urbanRural set Rural by the surrounding farmland/forest setting; everything else flagged uncertain.
